description: Recompress embedded images in a PDF. Presets are light, medium, and strong. Send base64 or a public URL. Private addresses are refused. An optional target size tries harder. Returns the PDF and the sizes before and after.

data.description: PDF bytes as base64 or a data URI. Decoded size is capped at 10 MB. Provide data or url.

targetBytes.description: Optional size ceiling in bytes, such as 102400.

url.description: Public URL of a PDF. Private and local addresses are refused. Provide data or url.

name: compress_pdf

data.description: PDF bytes as base64. The original is returned when compression would grow the file.

title: Compress a PDF
